title: Hyperband: A Novel Bandit-Based Approach to Hyperparameter Optimization

sections.mechanism: Hyperband allocates resources with successive halving across multiple brackets. It trades off the number of configurations against resources assigned to each configuration.
sections.limitations: The method depends on meaningful low-resource evaluations and does not itself provide a model-based proposal mechanism.

title: DEHB: Evolutionary Hyperband for Scalable, Robust and Efficient Hyperparameter Optimization

sections.mechanism: DEHB combines Differential Evolution with Hyperband. Differential Evolution proposes configurations while Hyperband supplies multi-fidelity resource allocation and selection.
sections.assumptions: It benefits when low-fidelity evaluations correlate with full-budget performance and when mutation and crossover can operate over the configuration representation.

title: Evolution of Heuristics: Towards Efficient Automatic Algorithm Design Using Large Language Model

sections.mechanism: Evolution of Heuristics uses an LLM inside an evolutionary framework to generate and improve executable heuristic ideas through prompt-based operators and fitness evaluation.
sections.comparison: The method targets automated heuristic design; PriEvO adds instance-specific landscape prior and optimize-while-evolve behavior for configuration tuning.
